findingDetails.title: Packet completion status contradicts active phase records
findingDetails.recommendation: Reconcile the parent status and goal completion checks against the child phase acceptance state.
findingDetails.claim: The root and goal claim completion while phase 2 AC-014 is Unmet and the child acceptance contract says that blocks closure.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Phase 5 is marked complete, but that does not satisfy phase 2 AC-014.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The parent and goal may have stale completion marks; the explicit unmet child criterion still blocks phase 2 closure.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade only if phase 2 AC-014 is changed to Met with evidence and the parent status is reconciled.

findingDetails.title: Staged type-change paths bypass the local-skill guard
findingDetails.recommendation: Include type-change entries in the staged-path scan or inspect all changed index paths before applying the private-path guard.
findingDetails.claim: The pre-commit hook's ACMR filter omits Git type-change status T before applying the local-* path regex.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: A fresh untracked local-* path is reported as added and caught; the gap is limited to a type change at an already tracked local-* path.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Keep at P2 unless a reachable tracked local-* path is shown to carry private payload through the omitted T status.

findingDetails.title: The scanner inventory omits the derived-freshness root scan
findingDetails.recommendation: Add ci-skill-derived-freshness.cjs to the scanner inventory and share the regenerator's root enumerator or explicitly exclude local-* by name.
findingDetails.claim: The phase 3 inventory claims sixteen top-level skill-root scans but omits ci-skill-derived-freshness.cjs, which separately enumerates SKILLS_DIR. That gate excludes symlinked local-* entries only as a side effect of Dirent.isDirectory and includes local-* real directories, unlike regenerate-skill-derived.cjs's explicit name exclusion.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The supported phase 4 layout uses symlinks, which Dirent.isDirectory skips, and the checker is read-only; the inventory may be intended to cover only scans changed by phase 3.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade if the inventory explicitly scopes out fleet freshness gates and the CI gate is shown to share a canonical local-* exclusion contract.
